sessions.macos: state.vscdb: SELECT value FROM composerHeaders WHERE isArchived = 0 ORDER BY recency DESC LIMIT 40
sessions.notes: Polled every 2 s (the writes land in the WAL sidecar). Fields: composerId, hasBlockingPendingActions | hasPendingPlan → waiting; unfinishedRunAt (set while a run is in flight, but it is the composer's creation time) plus conversationCheckpointLastUpdatedAt | lastUpdatedAt within 15 minutes and not before the editor's own start time → busy; otherwise dropped. Timestamps in epoch millis. The editor start time is the oldest Cursor process.
